column1: # mapping_set_title: "EU AI Act Annex VIII Section A (Art.49(1)) <-> SEMIC vocabularies"

# mapping_set_description: "Maps the 13 information items of Annex VIII Section A (provider of high-risk AI systems, Art.49(1)) to MLDCAT-AP 3.1.0, Schema.org and DPV EU AI Act. The bom: bridge concept in see_also provides the shared abstraction."

column8: comment
AI system provider (manufacturer/developer) maps to the entity responsible for making the ML model available; dcterms:publisher used on mldcatap:MachineLearningModel
The provider registers an ML model described as a mldcatap:MachineLearningModel instance; the registration item as a whole relates to this class
Submitter acting on behalf of the provider; PROV-O delegation relationship; MLDCAT-AP inherits prov: via dataset provenance chain
Authorised representative is a delegated agent; no dedicated MLDCAT-AP property — prov:actedOnBehalfOf on a foaf:Agent is the closest representation
Trade name of the AI system maps to dcterms:title on mldcatap:MachineLearningModel
System identifier/version number maps to dcterms:identifier on mldcatap:MachineLearningModel; version specifically to dcat:version
Version string of the AI system maps to dcat:version on mldcatap:MachineLearningModel
Intended purpose of the AI system maps directly to MachineLearningModel.intendedUse in MLDCAT-AP 3.1.0
Free-text description of functions also maps to dcterms:description on MachineLearningModel
Training data and algorithmic logic description maps to MachineLearningModel.designSpecifications in MLDCAT-AP 3.1.0
Training process details within A.6 map to MachineLearningModel.trainingProcess in MLDCAT-AP 3.1.0
Market status (available/withdrawn/recalled) maps to adms:status on the MachineLearningModel; MLDCAT-AP uses adms:status for dataset/model lifecycle status

column2: Member states where placed on market (A.10)
column8: Geographic market scope maps to dcterms:spatial (geographic coverage); no direct bom: bridge concept for geographic scope
Conformity assessment evidence is loosely related to the HarmRisk class in MLDCAT-AP 3.1.0; no direct equivalent for a formal conformity declaration
URL to instructions for use maps to dcat:landingPage on MachineLearningModel/Dataset
Optional additional URL maps to dcat:landingPage; relatedMatch because it is a generic supplementary link
schema:manufacturer (the entity that produced the AI system) supplements dcterms:publisher when the AI is described as a schema:SoftwareApplication
schema:name provides an exact match for the trade name of the AI system when described as a schema:SoftwareApplication
schema:softwareVersion is a closeMatch for the version number when the AI system is a schema:SoftwareApplication
schema:applicationCategory covers the application domain of the AI system when described as a schema:SoftwareApplication
Reference to a third-party conformity assessment certificate; schema:Certification is the nearest Schema.org type; no MLDCAT-AP equivalent
Copy or URL of the conformity assessment certificate; schema:Certification with schema:url is the closest representation; no MLDCAT-AP equivalent

column2: Member states where placed on market (A.10)
column8: schema:areaServed (geographic area where a product is available) supplements dcterms:spatial for market scope
EU declaration of conformity is a specific type of certification document; schema:Certification is the closest Schema.org type; no MLDCAT-AP equivalent for a formal conformity declaration
DPV EU AI Act eu-aiact:AIProvider (Art.3 def.) is the entity that develops or places the AI system on the market — close match for the registering provider; supplements dcterms:publisher
Submitter acting on behalf of the provider is a delegated AIProvider; relatedMatch because the submitter role is a delegation variant, not a distinct class in eu-aiact:
eu-aiact:AuthorisedRepresentative is defined in Art.3(6) EU AI Act as the EU-based representative appointed by a non-EU provider — exact semantic match
eu-aiact:IntendedPurpose (Art.3(12) EU AI Act) is the use for which an AI system is intended — exact semantic match for the A.5 intended purpose field
A.6 data and logic description is part of the technical documentation required under Art.11 EU AI Act; eu-aiact:TechnicalDocumentation encompasses this requirement
System architecture and algorithmic logic within A.6 maps to eu-aiact:SystemArchitectureDescription — more specific than TechnicalDocumentation
eu-aiact:MarketAvailabilityStatus directly represents the market availability state of the AI system — exact semantic match for the A.7 registration field
The A.8 certificate reference is evidence of a conformity assessment under Art.43 EU AI Act; eu-aiact:ConformityAssessment is the class covering this assessment
The A.9 certificate copy is documentation of the conformity assessment; same eu-aiact: mapping as A.8

eu-aiact:EUDeclarationOfConformity is explicitly defined in Art.47 EU AI Act — exact semantic match for A.11; fills the prior vocabulary gap where only schema:Certification (relatedMatch) was available
eu-aiact:InstructionForUse (Art.3(15) EU AI Act) is the information provided by the provider on intended use — exact semantic match for A.12
